sources.snippet: DINOv2, released by Meta Research in April 2023, implements a self-supervised method of training computer vision models. DINOv2 was trained using 140 million images without labels. The embeddings generated by DINOv2 can be used for classification, image retrieval, segmentation, and depth estimation.
